title: Umbral
subtitle: Darkness, silence, the End
text: Umbral tendency is shadow and concealment. It favors stealth, misdirection, and the quiet between heartbeats. Blood tempered in shadow becomes patient and precise. It learns to exist between moments — the space where light has not yet reached. Umbral-tended Hemomancers do not announce themselves. They are usually already where they need to be by the time anyone looks.
